hook.en: In 2019 Iman, the last Sumatran rhinoceros in Malaysia, died in Sabah. Once a species is gone, it is gone forever.
hook.bm: Pada 2019 Iman, badak sumbu Sumatera terakhir di Malaysia, mati di Sabah. Apabila sesuatu spesies pupus, ia hilang buat selama-lamanya.

bigIdeas.en: Malaysia's wildlife includes mammals, birds, reptiles, amphibians, fish and insects — many found nowhere else.

bigIdeas.en: Threats include habitat loss, poaching and illegal trade; protection comes from laws, parks and conservation centres.
bigIdeas.bm: Ancaman termasuk kehilangan habitat, pemburuan haram dan perdagangan haram; perlindungan melalui undang-undang, taman negara dan pusat pemuliharaan.
